text.description_html:
Contemporary Extra Long Stainless Steel Door Stop

Constructed of solid stainless steel this 6-1/2" extra long contemporary door stop screws onto the baseboard casement, door bottom or wall anchor, to protect not just the wall and door, but your door knob or lever as well.

Also available: 5-1/2" Long Door Stop, 4-1/2" Long Door Stop, 2" Short Door Stop

These extra long door stops are suited for special applications. Typically used to keep a door from hitting a obstacle mounted on a wall. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

For use in residential and commercial applications. Available in your choice of soft Satin Stainless Steel or bright Polished Stainless Steel finish.

Specifications of First Impressions DS-SS-6.5 Long Door Stop

  • Total Length: 6-1/2"
  • Diameter: 1/2"
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • White Rubber Bumper Tip

*Sold Individually




**This item is Discontinued. Use DWD-BDS650 Extra Long 6.5" Door Stop
